fact: The Majestic Mushroom is a colossal fungal structure with a hollow trunk carved with slitted windows.

fact: Thousands of smaller fungi cling to the vast central stalk of the Majestic Mushroom.

fact: A bridal procession of singing, marching fungal creatures swept through the grove.
